body:
Source: GitHub issue #804 (bug, security, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ de8a130a. plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs runs at module top level: `const raw = await stdinText();` at :447 with no surrounding `main()` and no `.catch`, unlike its siblings adlc-build-gate.mjs:395 and adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:1432, which both end with `main().catch((err) => fail(...))` and exit 2. `collectPaths` (:82-103), `collectCommandText` (:109-121) and `collectShellInvocations` (:384-399) recurse with no depth cap. Repro: a payload with ~20000 nested levels (about 120 KB of JSON) blows the stack inside collectPaths; the hook exits 1 with a RangeError stack trace. In Codex's PreToolUse convention exit 1 is a non-blocking error, so the tool call proceeds — a frozen-rail edit lands with a stack trace as the only signal. Payload shape is agent-controlled.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Plugin `plugins/adlc-codex`: hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs (enforcing; `fail(msg)` prints `adlc-rails-guard: <msg>` to stderr and exits 2 = deny; `notice` is stderr only; payload is parsed FIRST at :444-453 and the Recovery/Inspection exception block that follows must stay before ticket resolution — read the comment at :455-470 before moving anything), hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs (the isMain + `main().catch` pattern to copy, :392-400), hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs, hooks/generated-*.mjs (GENERATED copies — never hand-edit), hooks/hooks.json (invokes `node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs"`), hooks/test/helpers/run-hook.mjs (bounded `spawnHook`/`runHook` — use it; every existing test spawns the hook as a child process with `input:` and a temp repo, see hooks/test/shell-quoting.test.mjs `withRepo`/`shell` for the fixture shape). Nothing imports adlc-rails-guard.mjs as a module. Tests: the package has no `test` script; run `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs` from the worktree root (root runner segment `codex hooks`).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. The whole module body after the imports and helper definitions is wrapped in `async function main()`, guarded by the same `isMain` check build-gate uses (`import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href`), and invoked as `main().catch((err) => fail(`rails guard errored (${err?.message ?? 'unknown'}) — denying to fail closed`))`. Every `process.exit(0)` allow and every `fail` inside keeps its exact text and exit code; the hook's observable behaviour on every existing test is unchanged.
2. ONE pure, iterative (non-recursive) function `exceedsDepth(value, limit)` is defined in the hook and applied to the parsed payload immediately after JSON.parse succeeds and before the Recovery/Inspection exception block: it returns true when any nesting of arrays/objects goes deeper than `limit`. The limit is a single named constant `MAX_PAYLOAD_DEPTH = 64`. Exceeding it calls `fail('hook payload nesting exceeds 64 levels — refusing to classify it')` (exit 2). Rationale for the ordering: a payload too deep to classify cannot be shown to be a recovery command either.
3. Stdin read failures and JSON.parse failures remain `fail` (exit 2) — now by the same path as every other error, through main().catch.
4. Regression guards: allow outcomes still exit 0 with nothing on stdout; deny outcomes still exit 2 with the existing messages; the bare-inspection `pwd` fast path, the recovery exception, the shell classifier, and the audit-record behaviour are untouched; no change to adlc-build-gate.mjs or adlc-handoff-gate.mjs.
5. Documentation: in `docs/integrations/codex.md` (the Hooks and rails section, after the sentence ending `fail closed once enforcement is active.`) and by hand in `plugins/adlc-codex/README.md` (near line 51), add the statement that an internal error inside the rail guard, including a payload nested more than 64 levels deep, denies the tool call (exit 2) rather than falling through. Never regenerate either.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A payload nested 20000 levels deep (build it in the test; assert it is > 100 KB) sent to the hook in a repo with an active railed ticket → exit 2, stderr contains `nesting exceeds 64 levels`, stderr does NOT contain `RangeError` or `at collectPaths`. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/payload-depth-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC2 A payload nested exactly 64 levels that targets a NON-rail path → exit 0 (allowed; the cap is not hit); the same payload targeting a rail path → exit 2 with the existing frozen-rail message (classification still runs under the cap). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/payload-depth-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC3 `exceedsDepth` is iterative: called directly (export it, or re-derive it in the test from the hook source via a documented seam — state which in the PR body) with a 100000-deep array and limit 64 it returns true without throwing; with a flat object and limit 1 it returns false; with limit 0 and `{}` it returns true. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/payload-depth-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC4 An induced internal error denies: with a repo whose `.adlc/current-ticket.json` is a directory rather than a file (or another fixture that makes a later step throw rather than `fail`), the hook exits 2 and stderr contains `denying to fail closed` — never exit 1. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/payload-depth-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing hook suite green and unchanged. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Parity test still green (the hook text it compares is unchanged where it matters). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/prose-tool-line-parity.test.mjs`
- AC7 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "64 levels" docs/integrations/codex.md plugins/adlc-codex/README.md` (each >= 1)
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: the same missing cap in the copilot/claude-code/cursor rail guards (file follow-ups, do not fold in), adlc-build-gate.mjs and adlc-handoff-gate.mjs, hooks.json timeouts, #806 (Windows recovery exception), #850 (P1 flow docs).
title: adlc-codex: rails guard denies on any internal error and caps payload nesting instead of crashing open
